name: project-overview
description: A pane for one project at a time: its sessions with synopsis, effort and status, its issues, today's overview with carry-forward, its scheduled tasks, and a robotic gerbil PM in the middle.

projectsRoot.title: Projects root
projectsRoot.description: Folders whose first-level subfolders are projects, separated by semicolons; ~ is the home folder, so one setting serves Windows and a Mac. A session's cwd under one of them is grouped by that subfolder.

issuesFile.title: Issues file
issuesFile.description: Per-project issues file, relative to the project folder. Absent: the project's issues are on Jira.

estimateModel.title: Estimate model
estimateModel.description: Model that writes each session's one-line synopsis and hours estimate (an alias such as haiku, or a full model id).

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane re-reads sessions, tasks and issues in the background.

maxEstimatesPerRefresh.title: Estimates per refresh
maxEstimatesPerRefresh.description: How many sessions get a fresh synopsis/hours estimate per refresh (cost cap).

jiraProjects.title: Jira projects
jiraProjects.description: Which Jira project a project folder's issues live in, as folder=KEY pairs separated by commas; the pane then shows the folder's open sprint. A project's issues file wins when it names a Jira project.

jiraCloudId.title: Jira cloud id
jiraCloudId.description: The Atlassian site the Jira projects are on: its cloud id, or its hostname such as cortexgg.atlassian.net.

jiraServer.title: Jira MCP server
jiraServer.description: The key of the Atlassian connector's MCP server in this app (the part between mcp__ and __ in its tool names).

gerbils.title: Gerbil clan
gerbils.description: The clan: each project's gerbil PM, as folder=Name/coat pairs separated by commas (no-folder for the No folder sessions). Coats: agouti, black, argente-golden, cream, bew, dove, lilac, burmese, siamese, slate, nutmeg, honey, polar-fox, pied. A project left out is dealt a name and a coat no other project has; one renamed or recoloured in the pane keeps what was picked.
gerbils.default: butterfield_rrt=Butterscotch/argente-golden, rat=Butterscotch/argente-golden, seeker=Scout/agouti, SeekerScrapers=Digger/black, bragi=Skald/burmese, databasemanager=Ledger/dove, teamManagement=Roster/lilac, GUMS=Gumdrop/cream, tinkerbell=Pixie/bew, no-folder=Nomad/pied

openOnStart.title: Open at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it docks beside the chat when the window is wide enough).
